hero.heading: Sourcing, qualification, and freight — as one desk.
hero.body: AGL is a pallet brokerage. We don't own mills and we don't own trucks. These are the coordinated services behind every quote.

services.title: Spec sourcing
services.description: Translate the load into a buildable spec, then place it with shops already qualified to run it — with a backup source on the same footprint.

services.title: Mill & shop qualification
services.description: We buy from family-run mills and shops that build well. Qualification is ongoing: capacity, consistency, and how they communicate when something slips.

services.title: Managed freight
services.description: Freight is booked and tracked with the order. One number covers the pallets and the delivery window — not a handoff you have to chase.

services.title: Program coordination
services.description: Recurring volume, staggered plants, or seasonal spikes. We hold the schedule across sources so your receiving dock isn't the integration layer.

detail.heading: A quote is a plan, not a price scrap.
paragraphs: Send a spec and a quantity — or describe the failure mode you're tired of living with. We come back with sources, a freight path, and the assumptions underneath the number.
Custom and engineered work follows the same desk: we don't become the manufacturer; we find the shops set up to build the odd size and keep a second option warm.

ctaBand.heading: Ready for one desk on pallets and freight?
ctaBand.body: Same-day quotes when the spec is clear. No minimums. More than one qualified source on every spec we sell.
